reply.answer_text: If death is in January 2027, the fund passes to the bypass trust income-tax-free (if within two years, pre-75) and no pension-IHT charge applies under the old rules. If death is in June 2027, after 6 April 2027, the unused pension falls into the member's estate for IHT first — the bypass trust does not avoid that estate IHT. A direct spouse payment would be spouse-exempt under the new rules; paying to the bypass trust is not. The bypass trust keeps control and second-death benefits, but at the cost of possible first-death IHT. Any existing expression of wishes naming a bypass trust should be reviewed in light of this change.
